disposition_reason: The corrected development family produced zero positive cost-net Benjamini-Hochberg survivors across eight declared tests. This draft preserves the tested rule and unresolved requirements; it is not approved for preregistration, holdout evaluation, paper trading, or live deployment.
economic_hypothesis: Firms with high year-over-year net share issuance subsequently underperform firms retiring shares, so the intended spread is long low or negative issuance and short high issuance.

signal_rule.seasonal_match: latest reportperiod 330 to 410 calendar days before the current reportperiod
signal_rule.filing_deduplication: earliest datekey per ticker and reportperiod
signal_rule.out_of_order_guard: datekey must equal the running maximum datekey in reportperiod order
signal_rule.formation_visibility: only signals with datekey strictly before the formation session are eligible

direction.long: lowest net-share-issuance quintile, including negative issuance

formation_and_execution.formation_session: first observed SEP trading session of each calendar month
formation_and_execution.formation_price_use: formation-session close supplies dated market capitalization only
formation_and_execution.entry_timing: next observed session close after formation (T+1)

fixed_midcap_definition.reason: The development screen used relative dated-market-cap terciles; no ex ante fixed mid-cap bounds were selected.

dated_liquidity_eligibility.reason: No final point-in-time price, ADV, spread, or participation-rate thresholds are specified.

historical_borrow_locates_and_fees.reason: No dated locate availability, borrow-fee, recall, or short-financing inventory is available.

spread_slippage_impact_and_capacity.reason: The 120 bp development cost is a fixed convention, not a calibrated execution or capacity model.

statistical_power_and_independent_cohort.reason: No minimum detectable effect, required number of independent cohorts, or prospective stopping rule is specified.

holdout_source_and_acquisition_window.reason: No uncontaminated source, future acquisition dates, access controls, or immutable seal location have been selected.

corporate_action_economics.reason: The required corporate-actions table is absent from the local warehouse and action-sensitive return economics are not attested complete.
